title: Teamwork & Chores

scenes.t: {name} reads about Mona and Karim. Mona and Karim are at home.
Their mother asks them to do some chores.
First, they tidy up the living room.
Then, they clean the table and the floor.
Mona and Karim work together and share the chores. They are happy to help.
Finally, the house looks clean. Their mother smiles and says, 'Good job, team!'

items.a: Give part of what you have.
Put a flower or tree in the ground.

pairs: You put your bed in order.

activities.title: Helping at Home?
activities.prompt: Is it a chore at home?

why.y: It helps keep the house clean.
why.n: It is fun, not a chore.
